The '''Ementes''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of beings with six [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Their diet was made up entirely of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]]. The Ementes were known for their suspicion of others.<ref name="CSWE I 231" /> Members of the species had spread into [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="S" /> by [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]'' to [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].</ref> When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] and [[Kyp Durron]] met up for a drink at the [[Sanvia Vitajuice Bar]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Cantina/Legends|establishment's]] clientele was made up almost completely of Ementes. The frugivorous beings preferred Sanvia because they could watch their orders being prepared and thus make sure the bar employees gave them only fruit.<ref name="S" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ementes first appeared in the novel ''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]'', written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published by [[Del Rey]] in [[2007]].<ref name="S" />
